**Bottom line:** Expect elevated supply risk (73) and sharply rising prices (88) across all segments; lock in pricing where advised and press suppliers on lead‑time reductions.

## What changed
- Market supply risk holds at 73 ( +0.0 ) and price trend at 87.9 ( +0.0 ), both labeled “Elevated” and “Rising fast” respectively, with confidence 84 % [1].

- **10M08SAE144C8G** – lead time 52 weeks vs 12‑week norm, supply risk 80 , price +129 % vs target.
